connectorRun.runTypeTooltip: Select how you want to load data: incremental updates or full backfill for a period
connectorRun.manualBackfillDescription: Reloads all data for a specific time range from the source, replacing existing records for that period. Use when you need to correct or update historical data.
connectorRun.incrementalDescription: Adds only new or updated records since the last run, using the current state of your Data Mart as a reference. Ideal for keeping data fresh without reloading what's already there.
connectorRun.stateDescription: Connector state stores internal data between runs and updates automatically with each execution. It tracks progress and keeps data processing consistent across runs.
connectorRun.stateIncrementalDescription: Connector state is available only for connectors that support incremental runs. It adds only new or updated records since the last run without reloading existing data.

reportColumnPicker.filtersHelp: Filters narrow the final result — applied to the SELECT after all JOINs. Use slices below to narrow a joined data mart BEFORE it is JOINed in.
reportColumnPicker.slicesHelp:
Slices are pre-join filters: they narrow a joined data mart INSIDE its own subquery before the JOIN, reducing the rows pulled in.

Because joins are LEFT JOINs, a slice does NOT reduce the number of rows in the final result — main-mart rows that no longer match a sliced row pass through with NULL on the joined columns. To drop those rows from the output, add a Filter on the joined column above.
reportColumnPicker.sortHelp: Order rows in the final result. Drag to reorder priority; multiple columns are supported.
reportColumnPicker.limitHelp: Cap the number of rows returned. Applied last, after filters and sort. Leave empty for no limit.

roleHelp.question: Which role should I pick?
roleHelp.businessUser: sees accessible Data Marts and Reports, creates Reports for Data Marts available for reporting, manages Reports they own (edit, delete, change owners), manages Report Triggers under their Reports, and uses Destinations available for use. Cannot create, edit, or delete Data Marts, Data Mart Triggers, or Storages.
roleHelp.technicalUser: everything a Business User may do, plus: creates, edits, and deletes Data Marts, Data Mart Triggers, and Storages; edits and deletes Reports project-wide; changes Report owners; manages Report Triggers project-wide.
roleHelp.projectAdmin: everything a Technical User may do, plus: manages Project Members, manages billing, and manages general Project settings such as the Project title.

scopeHelp.question: What do the scopes mean?
scopeHelp.entireProject: the member sees every shared resource in the project (subject to role and ownership rules).
scopeHelp.selectedContexts: the member sees resources only if they share at least one assigned context, or if the member is an owner. Picking this with no contexts below is a valid "no shared access" state.

contextHelp.question: What are Contexts?
contextHelp.description: Contexts are business domains (e.g. Marketing, Finance, Sales) used to group Storages, Destinations and Data Marts. When this member's role scope is set to Selected contexts only, they will see a resource only if it is assigned to at least one of the contexts checked here (ownership still overrides visibility). With scope Entire project, these assignments have no effect.

publishForm.title: Publish a plugin
publishForm.description: Publishing lists a plugin so people can find it. It does not install it for anyone.
publishForm.repositoryHelp: A URL or owner/name. The plugin's versions come from its GitHub releases.
publishForm.repositoryRules: The repository must contain a plugin.json at its root and at least one published release tagged MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, with an optional leading v. Prereleases and build metadata are ignored, because the highest eligible version becomes current for everyone at once and nobody can pin an older one.
publishForm.repositoryIdentity: The repository — not its name — is the plugin's identity. Renaming or transferring it keeps the same plugin; two repositories are always two plugins, even with identical contents.
publishForm.repositoryAccess: A public repository works immediately. For a private one, the P2PDigital Data Marts GitHub App has to be installed on it first — publish it once and P2PDigital will show you the exact link to grant that access.
publishForm.scopeOnlyMe: Only me. The plugin appears in your Gallery and nobody else's. Available to every project member, and it needs no approval.
publishForm.scopeProject: Everyone in this project. Every member of this project finds it in their Gallery. Only a Project Admin can choose this.
publishForm.scopePublishOnly: Whichever you pick, publishing only makes the plugin findable. It installs it for nobody: each member still installs it themselves, and unpublishing later removes the listing without uninstalling anyone.
publishForm.scopeIndependent: The levels are independent, so the same plugin can be listed at both and still appears once. You can widen a personal listing to the whole project later from the plugin's own page.
publishForm.grantAccess: Give P2PDigital Data Marts access to this repository
